# ValidateRequired

Checks that an object has a usable value for each of a list of field names.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
ValidateRequired(source, fields)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | object | The object to check. Null is read as an empty object, so every field is missing. Any other type that is not an object is a runtime error. |
| `fields` | array | An array of the field names to check, each a string. Null is read as an empty array. An element that is not a string is a runtime error, raised before any field is checked. |

## Returns

Object. An object with two properties: `valid`, true when no field failed, and `errors`, an array holding one object of `field` (the name) and `reason` (`"missing"`, `"null"` or `"empty"`) for each name that failed, in the order of fields; a name listed twice that fails is reported twice. Never null.

## Remarks

A field fails when the object has no property of that name (reason `"missing"`), when its value is null (reason `"null"`), or when its value is a string that is empty or holds only white space (reason `"empty"`). Any other value passes, including `0`, `false`, an empty array and an empty object. Each name is one key, looked up as written: a name with a dot in it is never read as a path.

## Example

`ValidateRequired({ "name": " ", "age": 3 }, ["name", "age", "email"])` returns `{ "valid": false, "errors": [{ "field": "name", "reason": "empty" }, { "field": "email", "reason": "missing" }] }`.
